simple.meaning: בָּלַם (bâlam) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to muzzle.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Psalms, beginning at Psalms 32:9. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּלַם (H1102) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: בָּלַם (bâlam) / H1102 is traced through Psalms 32:9 with source-language evidence and verse context.
